slides.title: One root is handed to you. Find the other in ==10 seconds==.

slides.stem: If 3x² + kx − 14 = 0 has x = 2 as a root, what is the other root?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: A — x = −7/3
slides.body: Vieta's gives the product of roots as c/a=(−14)/3. Most students pick B (x = 7/3): drops the negative sign on the root.

slides.title: Back-Solve Parameter, Then Find Other Root
slides.body: When one root of ax²+bx+c=0 is given, use Vieta's: the product of the roots is c/a, so divide by the known root to get the other.
